description: Replace the Telegram alert filters. Send the COMPLETE `sellerFilter` and/or `buyerFilter` objects (read the current ones with `tronsave_get_telegram_notify_setting`, edit, send back); each range or value has `isEnabled` plus its numbers. Only changes which alerts are sent; no funds move. Idempotent. Requires a wallet signature identity and a linked Telegram account.

buyerFilter.description: Complete buyer alert filter; omit to leave buyer alerts unchanged.

isEnabled.description: Master switch for buyer alerts (your delegations and resources).

lowResourceAlertBandwidth.description: Alert when remaining BANDWIDTH units of the receiver is reached.

value.description: Threshold: remaining BANDWIDTH units of the receiver.

lowResourceAlertEnergy.description: Alert when remaining ENERGY units of the receiver is reached.

value.description: Threshold: remaining ENERGY units of the receiver.

reclaimAlertTime.description: Alert when seconds left before a delegation is reclaimed is reached.

value.description: Threshold: seconds left before a delegation is reclaimed.

sellerFilter.description: Complete seller alert filter; omit to leave seller alerts unchanged.

apy.description: Alert only for orders whose seller APY in percent is in this range.

isEnabled.description: Whether this range filter is applied.

duration.description: Alert only for orders whose rental duration in seconds is in this range.

isEnabled.description: Whether this range filter is applied.
Master switch for seller alerts (new buy orders on the market).

onlySendUnlockOrders.description: true alerts only for orders that do not lock the seller's resource.

price.description: Alert only for orders whose unit price in SUN is in this range.

isEnabled.description: Whether this range filter is applied.

remainAmount.description: Alert only for orders whose remaining unfilled resource units is in this range.

isEnabled.description: Whether this range filter is applied.

name: tronsave_update_telegram_notify_setting
title: Update Telegram Notification Settings
